method: Two independent passes. Pass 1 re-derived 143 headline numeric statements directly from the frozen empirical artifacts without consulting the Task 19 map, including the full calendar decomposition, the AUC pair decomposition, every CIF cell and every frozen interval endpoint. Pass 2 resolved all 257 Task 19 bindings against their own named artifact and JSON pointer and compared the resolved value to the recorded exact_value. The brief required that the map itself be verified, not trusted.

pass_1_independent_rederivation.scope: Table B, C, D, E, F, G values; abstract numbers; conclusion numbers; calendar weights and contributions; geometry diagnostics; split counts.
pass_1_independent_rederivation.attestation_note: Reviewer attestation. The working file for this pass was written to a scratch location and not committed, so its sequence relative to opening the evidence map is not independently established (T20-C14). Pass 2 and the user-side audit independently resolve all 257 bindings.

non_value_findings.finding: 'other scores do not uniformly improve' omits that default calibration also degrades on unseen vintages (slope 1.0091 -> 0.7639; M2 under-predicts default 3.5x). M1's values are weak-calibration evidence only, per T20-C04. Default calibration is never reported anywhere in the manuscript.

verdict: No value errors and no source errors in 257 bindings. The evidence chain is the strongest part of this manuscript and it withstood independent verification. All four surviving findings concern what the numbers are taken to mean or what is omitted, not whether they are right.

bindings.displayed: unemployment_level, unemployment_change_3m, treasury_10y_level, mortgage_30y_level, hpi_yoy, cpi_yoy, gdp_qoq

withdrawn_findings.finding: Model columns are means of facility-level CIFs; the observed column is a cohort-level Aalen-Johansen estimate. Different functionals compared in adjacent columns without a note.

withdrawn_findings.locus: section 4.4 and abstract sentence 7, bindings Q0167/Q0168
withdrawn_findings.finding: The 1.81%/98.19% contribution shares are correct arithmetic but are presented as a property of the models rather than of the chosen stratum resolution. At month resolution the pair weights are 1.979%/98.021%. The share is not invariant; the within-stratum gain is.
withdrawn_findings.reason: v0.3 labels the year decomposition as year-level; the finding also wrongly called within-stratum gains invariant and conflated month pair weights with contribution shares. Retained as a presentation recommendation (R3), not a manuscript interpretation error.

withdrawn_findings.finding: General capability claim with no population, model or period scope.
withdrawn_findings.reason: Modal statement of possibility, not a universal scope claim.
